properties.NAME: Erie Dist. (MI Terr)
properties.CHANGE: U.S. created Michigan Territory from Indiana Territory. On 3 July 1805, Erie District was created in Michigan Territory by Territorial Governor William Hull as a county precursor; included part of present Indiana and the area disputed with Ohio.
properties.CITATION: (Terr. Papers U.S., 10:5-7; U.S. Stat., vol. 2, ch. 5 [1805]/pp. 309-310; "Territorial Records," 118-121; Blume, 1:2-4)
